run_hvp: run hvp to compute an efficient vector-Hessian product of a loss function evaluated at given params, inputs, and targets
build_hessian_diag: build the diagonal of the Hessian matrix of a loss function using hessian_diag with params, inputs, and targets
compute_fisher_diag: compute the diagonal of the observed Fisher information matrix from a negative log likelihood function
